reddit.title: Improved Performance for Flowing Water in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant optimizations to how flowing water is processed in Provincia. Now, when a wet cell dries, only that cell and its immediate neighbors are updated, reducing the script time for a 64x64 lake from about 20 ms to just 12 ms. This means smoother gameplay without the previous frame hitches. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/cutting-flowing-water-cost?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cutting-flowing-water-cost
